Name: (CP) Desert Oasis
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
I made a little Oasis map for a cutscene for my Qi mod and I liked the way it looked so I wanted to make it into something the player could run around in and use for... whatever (maybe a tree farm or something) - I also just wanted to work on my map making skills so I made this :) please enjoy
[b][u]
How to get there:[/u][/b] Unlock the desert via the community center and it should appear on the bus stop list as "Desert Oasis"

You can fish up desert fish there (this allow for you to catch iridium quality fish without having to use quality bobbers or anything)

[u][b]Compatibility:[/b][/u]
Should be compatible with everything since the location is not connected to anything :)

[i][b][center]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/center][/b][/i]
